name: atlas-ops-analytical-scorecard
description: Use when a task delivers a business "scorecard", "reconciliation", "review", "backlog", or "correction" as three files — a prompt, a request-policy JSON (scope, business definitions, rollups, tie-breaks, rounding, status rules), and an answer_template.json — to be computed against an authenticated, read-only SQL workplace/operations database and written as one JSON object to answer.json. Covers eligibility cohorts, "effective/canonical" entity reduction, exact UTC windows, rate/rounding rules, worst/top-N ordering with tie-breaks, ordered status-rule cascades, and single-row canonical corrections with an audit record.
